title: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets

task.value: Benchmarking LLM agents on end-to-end daily portfolio construction over CSI300 stocks while controlling pretraining-memory leakage and attributing returns to market, style, and selection alpha.
task.quote: The task is daily portfolio construction over the CSI300 constituent universe.

architecture.value: Qlib-based execution engine; four-level data-side masking (bright, stock-blind, date-blind, blinded); three decision modes (memory-only, fixed-candidate, open-research); ReAct-style research-then-submission loop with six read-only tools; ten-dimensional metric panel; Barra-style attribution.
architecture.quote: It has four interlocking components—a four-level masking protocol (§3.3), three decision modes (§3.2), a Qlib-based execution engine (§3.1), and a ten-dimensional metric panel (§3.6)—each described below.

data.value: Chinese A-share CSI300 constituents, daily price-only data: OHLCV histories and derived technical features; no news, filings, or fundamentals.
data.quote: Observations are price-only: OHLCV histories and derived technical features. The benchmark contains no news, analyst reports, regulatory filings, or fundamentals

window.value: Long window 2024-01-01 to 2026-04-10 (548 trading days) for headline; ten ~43-trading-day regime windows W1–W10 for anchor analysis. Baselines trained 2008–2022, validated 2023 (intro elsewhere says 2015–2022).
window.quote: We evaluate on ten regime-stratified short windows of \sim 43 trading days each (W1–W10, Table 2) plus one contiguous long window from 2024-01-01 to 2026-04-10 (548 trading days).

models.value: Anchor Step-3.5-Flash; ten LLMs: qwen3.6-plus, gpt-5.5, doubao-seed-2.0, claude-opus-4-7, minimax-m2.7, step-3.5-flash, gemini-3.1-pro, deepseek-v4-pro, glm-5.1, kimi-k2.6; temperature 0.0.
models.quote: one model each from Step, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, ByteDance, DeepSeek, Alibaba, MiniMax, Zhipu, and Moonshot (full identifiers in Table 4)

baselines.value: Eighteen Qlib factor models on nine Alpha9 features (e.g., SFM, DoubleEnsemble, CatBoost, LightGBM, Transformer, LSTM, MLP, Linear) plus CSI300 buy-and-hold.
baselines.quote: We benchmark the ten LLM agents against eighteen trained Qlib factor models on the long window.

headline_result.value: On 2024-01-01 to 2026-04-10, best LLM qwen3.6-plus +85.29% total return (Sharpe 1.13) vs CSI300 +36.92% and SFM +86.58%; only Claude Opus 4.7 has non-negative selection alpha (+0.2%).

costs.value: 5 bps buy cost, 15 bps sell cost, CNY 5 minimum per order, next-day open execution, T+1, price-limit filtering; inference: 6–12 h wall-clock per LLM on long window with three seeds.
costs.quote: long-only positions starting from CNY 1,000,000; T+1 sell availability; CNY 5 minimum cost per order; 5 bps buy cost and 15 bps sell cost. Orders execute at the next-day open price.

uncertainty.value: Multiple seeds per model (5 for anchor, 3 for long window); medians with IQR; Wilcoxon signed-rank tests at α=0.05; Wilson 95% CIs on probe.
uncertainty.quote: Multi-seed cells report median total return with [Q_{1},Q_{3}] as IQR; cross-condition contrasts use Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on paired (window, seed) medians at \alpha=0.05 .

leakage_controls.value: Data-side masking anonymizing tickers, dates and tool-return timestamps, aliases shuffled across episodes; ten-attacker de-anonymization probe (top-1 ticker ≤3.0%, joint ≤1.5%); W10 post-cutoff for anchor; tools see only prior-day data.
leakage_controls.quote: an independent ten-attacker probe (Section 4.3) certifies the mask, with top-1 ticker recovery at most 3.0\% and a strict joint (ticker top-5 and date within \pm 7 trading days) rate at most 1.5\% .

limitations.value: Only CSI300 with price-only inputs; no US/HK equities or news/filings/macro; full mask×mode×window grid run only on Step-3.5-Flash, others only blinded×open-research due to compute.
limitations.quote: The current implementation focuses on the CSI300 A-share universe with a price-only observation channel (open, high, low, close, volume, and derived technical factors); it does not cover US or Hong Kong equities, nor multimodal inputs such as archived news, filings, or macroeconomic series.

release.value: Authors state public release of environment, scripts, masking and probe protocols, and full evaluation dataset; no location given.
release.quote: (3) Public release of environment, scripts, masking and probe protocols, and the full evaluation dataset.
